name: Fine Organic Industries Limited
summary: Fine Organic Industries Limited engages in manufacture, processing, supply, distribution, dealing, import, and export of oleochemical-based additives in India and internationally. The company offers food ingredient, such as emulsifiers, antifungal agents, bakery products, starch complexity agents, viscosity modifiers, anti-blooming agents, anti-splattering agents, crystal promoters, and anti-foam agents.
